subject: MSA / Order Form: proposed security exhibit redlines & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: NOVA Legal <legal@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: MSA / Order Form - security exhibit questions (SOC 2 + pen test)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the draft order form — attached is a redline from our procurement team and the SOC 2 Type II report you requested. A couple of items Legal flagged that we want to confirm before we route for signature: 

1) Audit / inspection right: we prefer a 30-day notice window and up to two sampling inspections per year; would Redwood accept limiting live inspection to tenant-scoped sampling rather than full production access?
2) Pen test access: NOVA requires a short staging window and a list of approved IP ranges for the testing. Is there an operations contact we can coordinate with?
3) Evidence cadence: our security team asked for a quarterly evidence handoff for the first year (configurations, SOC-2 evidence summary, summary of pen test findings). Is that something you can commit to in the Order Form appendix?

I've attached the redlined OrderForm_v2 for quick reference. If helpful, legal included suggested language — I've copied the relevant clauses in the attached. Can you loop in your legal/assurance contact and let us know where Redwood stands? We are trying to close by end of month.

Appreciate it,
Oliver

Attachments: NovaMed_OrderForm_v2.docx (docx), SOC2-Type2-Report-2026.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - security exhibit questions (SOC 2 + pen test)

Hi Oliver — thanks for the redline and SOC report. I've looped in our legal lead (Laura) and Assurance (Vanessa) to confirm details. Quick operational answers while they weigh in: 

• Staging window & pen test ops: yes — we typically provide a pre-production/staging environment for pen-tests and can publish an approved IP list for Nova's vendor. I will introduce you to our ops lead after Laura confirms the order form language.
• Inspection scope: we're comfortable with tenant-scoped sampling (bounded inspection). We prefer the clause to include defined sampling bands and an option for ephemeral inspection accounts rather than broad production credentials.
• Evidence cadence: Redwood can commit to a quarterly evidence summary for 12 months post-activation; we normally provide a bundled package (SOC-2 attest, configuration snapshot, and test summary).

Laura / Vanessa — can you review NOVA's proposed changes (attached) and advise on the redline we should return? High-level asks from NOVA are: 30-day notice, two sampling inspections/year, quarterly evidence handoffs Year 1, and staging window details for pen-test vendors. Thanks.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: NovaMed - suggested redline language and ops plan (please advise)

Laura / Vanessa — quick internal note so we have a single return to NOVA. I pulled NOVA's language into two buckets: inspection/audit rights and pen-test staging. My initial thoughts below; please edit.

1) Inspection / Audit Rights (recommended):
- Keep 'audit rights' but tighten to 'tenant-scoped inspection' with explicit sampling bands (e.g., access to logs and traces for specified services up to 7 days of data and up to 2 inspection events per 12-month period).
- Add operations-friendly controls: 30-day notice (ok), predetermined calendar windows (we propose 45-day rolling windows they pick twice/year), and ephemeral read-only credentials issued for inspection only.
- Avoid language that allows full-production SSH/RDP or on-prem screensharing — propose 'evidence handover' or 'joint review sessions' instead.

2) Pen Test (recommended):
- Approve staging-window testing with strict scope: vendor must use pre-prod environment, provide test plan 10 days in advance, and limit to approved IP ranges. No live customer data to be used.
- Require coordinated rollback & ops contact (we can provide).

3) Evidence cadence (recommended):
- Commit to quarterly evidence package for 12 months post-contract signature. Package = snapshot of attestation artifacts (SOC 2 summary), high-level config export, and a short risk-summary for any pen test findings.

If we can get Laura to convert the language into a short exhibit we can return to NOVA today. We should also include a short paragraph in the Order Form appendix that the 'security exhibit' supersedes general inspection language where inconsistent.

Marissa — once Laura signs off, could you please prepare the appendix doc and a short companion Ops checklist (approved IP ranges, staging contact, test plan template) so we can attach it to the DocuSign?

Thanks — please redline inline and I will send to NOVA.

—Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 14:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: NovaMed - suggested redline language and ops plan (please advise)

Thanks Jordan — reviewed and edited. Attached is a one-page Security Exhibit we can return that mirrors our standard limited-inspection language and enumerates the evidence package. Highlights:

• Limited inspection: up to two tenant-scoped inspections in a 12-month period; 30-day notice; ephemeral read-only access; no remote control or production-side CLI/SSH.
• Pen-test: must be conducted in a customer-equivalent staging environment, test plan due 10 business days in advance, allowed IP ranges will be pre-shared; Redwood will assign an ops contact to coordinate and validate rollback procedures.
• Evidence cadence: quarterly evidence package for 12 months post-execution. We clarify that the evidence package is a summary and not a copy of raw logs or customer data.
• If NOVA needs a full forensic inspection or broader access, that will be scoped as a separate professional services engagement.

I've attached the exhibit PDF and a short Ops checklist that Marissa can format for DocuSign. If everyone is good, Jordan please send as "Redwood proposed security exhibit" and attach the two documents.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0124
